name: Trino
summary: Run queries against a Trino coordinator and keep the results as Parquet. Writes go through a catalog that can read staged Parquet, once per partition and revision.

fields.name: username
fields.label: User name
fields.help: Sent as the query user. Trino does not check it when authentication is off.

fields.name: jwt_token
fields.label: JWT
fields.help: A signed token that the coordinator is configured to accept.

egress.note: 8443 and 8080 are the usual HTTPS and HTTP ports of a coordinator; the port setting overrides them.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query and keep the result as Parquet.
Insert staged Parquet into a table through a catalog that can read it, once per partition and revision.

notes: Loading needs a catalog whose connector can read Parquet from object storage, such as Hive, and permission to write. Trino does not store data itself; add the staging store's connector domains to the same egress approval.
